values.note: recreation.gov's rate table charges $10 a night (PeakPrimitive, every season 2020-2028); the same listing's fee description says 'Camping fees at $14 per night'.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10056267/rates (Peak Season 2026, 2027, 2028: PeakPrimitive 10) + facility_use_fee_description ('Camping fees at $14 per night. Fees must be paid when reserving a site'), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite search (all 14 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC, no hookup attributes) + description ('There is a hand pump for non-potable water'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Two loops: A (sites 1-10) and B (11-14), gravel driveways; sites 1, 4 and 6 pull-through, 10 parallel. recreation.gov lists only 'Pop up' as permitted equipment on every site, with no length. One wheeled unit per site. Six more hike/bike/ride/boat-in sites lie out on the peninsula (not part of this campground's booking).

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite search (loops A/B, Driveway Entry Pull-through on 1/4/6, Parallel on 10, Driveway Surface Gravel, permitted_equipment 'Pop up' max_length 0 on all 14) + notices ('Maximum occupancy per campsite is ONE (1) wheeled unit') + overview ('six hike/bike/ride/boat in camping/picnic sites'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: A hand pump for non-potable water. Pack in/pack out: no dumpsters.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10056267 ('two loops of campsites, each with a vaulted pit toilet. There is a hand pump for non-potable water.', 'Pack In/Pack Out. Dumpsters are not provided.'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Fees are paid when reserving online or at 877-444-6777; 'DO NOT CALL the campground' to make or cancel. 14 nights in a rolling 30. Check-in 3 pm, check-out 2 pm. Unstaffed. The 2026-27 calendar shows 20 October-31 December 'Not Reservable', January-February 'Closed' and sites bookable from 1 March 2027.

booking.source: recreation.gov notices ('Reservations can be made up to 240 days in advance of desired date', 'Check-In is at 3:00 PM & Check Out is at 2:00 PM'), facility_rules (maxStay 14, 'Rolling 30 Days'), Contact Info ('This location is unstaffed'), availability calendar 2026-10 to 2027-03, read 2026-10-30

note: USACE J. Strom Thurmond (Clarks Hill) Lake, Savannah District, at the entrance to the Bussey Point wilderness recreation area, a 2,545-acre peninsula with a boat ramp, natural beaches and a 12.5-mile horse trail; serves riders and mountain bikers but is a general campground. The last 0.5 mi is dirt road past the end of the pavement. Heavily wooded pine and hardwood. --Claude
summary: rec.gov: confirmed $10 (2026-2028 rate table; the fee text says $14), 14 non-electric sites in two loops with pull-throughs, vault toilets, reservable 240 days out, 14-night max. Changed potable_water true -> false (hand pump is 'non-potable'). Note cleaned ($6 was wrong; field facts dropped). rec.gov states no season and no site lengths.
